target.statement: Sequential BiFLICKER attains overall ARI of 0.94 on the LastFM user-artist network (federated by country), close to centralized spectral clustering.
target.dataset: LastFM user-artist bipartite network (Celma 2010), partitioned by country

compute.basis: No code is released and the exact LastFM preprocessing, country partitioning, and target-selection details are not specified, so the whole federated pipeline (local SVD calibration, sequential projected FLICKER, k-means, ARI) must be reimplemented from scratch; the matrix itself is small enough for CPU.

blockers: LastFM dataset provenance/preprocessing and country partition not specified
Exact target singular-value selection and step-size choices must be reverse-engineered
title: Federated Community Detection in Bipartite Networks
